experiment_data.hypothesis: Detach BN on libero_object benchmark (seed 42): Tests whether detaching gradient flow neutralizes OCC head damage on object suite, mirroring libero_spatial findings. If Detach BN CAR ≈ Vanilla (i.e., harmless), supports cross-benchmark generalizability of the detach mechanism. Combined with full_occ_bn_object_s0 and vanilla_object, enables factorial comparison on object suite.
